_comment: NPCs added to maps beyond what Map.wz ships. Kept here rather than edited into the converted WZ JSON so that re-running tools/wz-to-json.js cannot silently delete them. Keyed by map id; each entry takes the same fields as a Map.wz 'life' node of type 'n'.

910000000._note: Maple Administrator, Free Market entrance. Stands on foothold 32 (x 135..225, y -176), the clear stretch of the entrance platform between Fredrick (x=83) and Scrooge (x=288). Sells the Maple item set — shop 9010000 in shops.json.
